title: inside the statue of liberty’s torch?
content: this is a dream that i had a long time ago but i remember it vividly, i thought it was just another random dream but it seems like there are multiple people that have reported having this dream, there were like windows surrounding me and some weird buttons or stuff on the rounded table ? and a door and when you open the door there is this spiral staircase, i wonder how many people on here also experienced this
